body: The completed reassessment found no language feature requiring an MSRV increase. Actual consumer builds pass with Rust 1.71 for std and Rust 1.81 for the declared no_std configuration, using compatible dependency locks; the final source also cross-compiles for both Apple architectures. The existing declared policy is preserved. Closing my policy proposal as not planned; the fixes are tracked in #323, #327 and #328. Agent-assisted update.
